scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run build:core && npm run test:browser && npm run test:vscode
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:browser && npm run build:vscode && npm run verify:build
scripts.package: npm run package:browser && npm run package:vscode

scripts.package:vscode: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:core && npm run build:vscode && node scripts/package-vscode.mjs

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:browser && npm run typecheck:vscode
